instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only halation. Set halation to: clean existing lamp edges, no bleed into adjacent darks, no new lights. Bleed only lamps and speculars already in the source image. Do not add lamps, rims, suns, or glowing eyes. Do not globally soften. Do not change time of day. Do not move the key. Do not add grain or a genre.
hold_constant: Bleed only lamps and speculars already in the source image. Do not add lamps, rims, suns, or glowing eyes. Do not globally soften. Do not change time of day. Do not move the key. Do not add grain or a genre.
